Understanding the concept of a family of antiderivatives (họ nguyên hàm) does not require prior knowledge of a summary table of common antiderivatives (bảng nguyên hàm). The prerequisite direction should be reversed or, more accurately, no strong prerequisite relation exists here; the table is a derived application, not a prerequisite for the concept.
